tagline: Global leader in automotive seating systems and components.
hero_kpi_rationale: Gross margin directly measures Adient's operational profitability and its ability to manage production costs in the automotive industry, reflecting its capacity to absorb inflationary pressures and maintain competitiveness.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue remaining after deducting cost of goods sold.
kpis.description: Measures the direct profitability of products sold by Adient.

kpis.name: Op Margin
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue remaining after deducting operating expenses.
kpis.description: Indicates the profitability of Adient's core operations before interest and taxes.
kpis.signal: Reflects the efficiency of the company's overall management.

kpis.name: R&D
kpis.explanation: Spending on research and development for automotive seating technologies.
kpis.description: Measures Adient's investment in developing new technologies and products for the automotive industry.
kpis.signal: Indicates Adient's commitment to product innovation and advanced seating technologies.

kpis.name: Capex
kpis.explanation: Spending on tangible and intangible assets for maintenance and expansion of capacity.
kpis.description: Represents Adient's investments in its manufacturing facilities and seat production equipment.
kpis.signal: Indicator of future expansion and maintenance of production capacity.

kpis.name: Headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees working for the company worldwide.
kpis.description: Adient's total number of employees across its global operations in over 200 facilities.
kpis.signal: Reflects the company's operational scale and productivity potential.

risks.title: Margin pressures in Asia due to Chinese OEMs
risks.score_rationale: The risk is cited as causing modest but ongoing margin declines, with high intensity in the text (e.g., 'pricing pressures', 'intensifying competition from Chinese imports'). It is repeated across multiple sections and linked to a structural trend of rising local OEMs in China, reinforcing its severity. The Competition category is heavily weighted here.

risks.title: Declining automotive demand and overcapacity in EMEA
risks.score_rationale: The text mentions a $333 million goodwill impairment directly tied to lower expected volumes in EMEA. The language is alarming ('overcapacity', 'pricing pressure', 'intensifying competition'). This risk is central to the asset valuation analysis and exacerbated by significant volume issues in Europe, making it existential for the region.

risks.title: Impacts of supply chain disruptions
risks.score_rationale: The text highlights persistent disruptions, unplanned shutdowns, operational inefficiencies, and a supply chain still fragile. The intensity of language ('supply chain disruptions', 'shortages of critical components') and direct impact on production justify a high severity. The Industrial category is moderately weighted.

risks.title: Exposure to currency fluctuations
risks.score_rationale: The risk is explicitly linked to financial results volatility and period-over-period comparability. The text mentions hedging policies but emphasizes their insufficiency. Exposure is recurring and affects financial stability as a multinational group operating in 29 countries, with high weighting for the Capital category.

risks.title: Dependence on inaccurate customer forecasts
risks.score_rationale: The risk is mentioned as potentially having an 'adverse impact' but without quantified losses. The language is moderate. It is stable year-over-year and tied to a classic automotive sector operational risk, with medium weighting for the Industrial category.

risks.title: Risks related to raw material and energy costs
risks.score_rationale: The text describes 'significant' volatility in material, energy, freight, and labor prices, with a persistent impact expected in fiscal 2026. The risk directly affects Adient's gross margins (6.6% in 2025 vs 6.3% in 2024) and is repeatedly cited as a key pressure factor, with high weighting for the Macro category.

risks.title: Russia-Ukraine conflict and economic sanctions
risks.score_rationale: The text mentions impacts on energy costs, supply chains, and geopolitical uncertainties. Although Adient no longer has operations in Russia, its suppliers and customers are affected. The language emphasizes risks ('geopolitical uncertainties', 'impact on supply chain'), and the conflict in Ukraine continues to affect the EMEA region, with high weighting for Geopolitical.

ai_positioning.summary: No significant mention of artificial intelligence was found in the text.
